stable.headline: A section view that cuts the scene with a plane, a Photo mode with a toolbar, lens rings and softboxes, Remove thickness, textures in OBJ and FBX exports, and 17 fixes.
notes: Section view: cut the whole scene with one plane to look inside (Explode still works)
Photo mode with a toolbar of its own, lens rings under V and softboxes in the reflections
Remove thickness: a pipe keeps its outside, a bent sheet one face
OBJ and FBX exports carry their textures, and normal maps come out the right way up
Profile: round, grow and trim the outline; every value slider is a fill bar
17 fixes: a group volume larger than the group, blurry textures at a slant, dark CAD looks, Simplify round faces on pipes
